metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 회전 보간 ① 두 자세 사이의 경로와 속도
metadata.description:
두 자세를 알고 있다면 그 사이의 자연스러운 움직임은 어떻게 만들까요? 같은 몸체와 기준축을 유지하며 각도의 짧은 경로, 선형 보간, 쿼터니언 보간, 시간에 따른 속도를 차례로 연결합니다. 마지막에는 같은 시작과 끝을 두고 시간 함수를 바꿨을 때 중간 자세가 어떻게 달라지는지 작은 숫자로 확인합니다. 두 편 중 첫 번째 강의입니다.

englishMetadata.title: Game Mathematics Part 2: Rotation Interpolation 1 — Paths and Timing Between Orientations
englishMetadata.description:
Given two orientations, how do we create a natural motion between them? Keeping the same body and reference axes, we connect the short angular path, linear interpolation, quaternion interpolation and speed over time. We then use small numbers to compare intermediate orientations when the time function changes but both endpoints stay the same. This is the first of two lectures.

Game Math PART2 course materials
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

40% actual gameplay and 60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Overview: the motion between two orientations
01:32 Blending numbers while preserving a rotation
02:47 A small-number rotation example
03:30 An endpoint does not record the full path
04:56 SLERP follows a unit-sphere arc
05:58 Nearly identical orientations and invalid inputs
07:40 Calculate the middle of a ninety-degree rotation
08:21 NLERP preserves rotation but changes speed
10:10 Constant speed also requires a time condition
10:45 Linear and squared time on the same endpoints
12:26 Read body directions in flight and skiing
13:36 Pass the intermediate orientation to the next task
14:47 Recap and the next question
15:07 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.
